svg.text: V3 Pro clamshell workstation: CNC cut sheets
4 sheets of 4 x 8 ft plywood, 3/4 in thick (T). Red = outside profile, blue = inside cuts, green = 1/4 in drill. Inches.
Sheet 1 of 4 (V3_sheet1.dxf: 4 parts, 92% of the sheet)
Sheet 2 of 4 (V3_sheet2.dxf: 14 parts, 88% of the sheet)
Sheet 3 of 4 (V3_sheet3.dxf: 13 parts, 87% of the sheet)
Sheet 4 of 4 (V3_sheet4.dxf: 18 parts, 56% of the sheet)
V3-08 A Door, hinge side x1
V3-09 A Door, free side x1
V3-33 Stool leg A (slot from top) x1
V3-34 Stool leg B (slot from bottom) x1
